response.evidence_available: An authenticated user (ID 2841) requested GET /api/invoices/9281 and received a 200 OK response containing invoice details. Invoice IDs are known to be sequential.
response.evidence_missing: Information showing whether invoice 9281 belongs to user 2841 or to a different user. To prove an authorization vulnerability (BOLA/IDOR), we need to observe an access attempt by a user who does not own the requested invoice and lacks the privileges to view it, and see that access is permitted.
response.safe_verification_procedure: In an isolated test environment, register two distinct test users: User A and User B. Create an invoice (e.g., ID 9282) belonging to User B. Attempt to retrieve ID 9282 using the authentication session of User A. If the API returns a 200 OK with the invoice details, the system is vulnerable. If it returns 403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found, it is secure.
